Offline glTF codecs are copied from npm three@0.185.0/examples/jsm.

Three.js loaders, WorkerPool, ColorSpaces: MIT, see THREE-LICENSE.txt.
Draco wrapper and WASM: Google, Apache-2.0, see DRACO-LICENSE.txt.
Basis Universal wrapper and WASM: Binomial LLC, Apache-2.0, see BASIS-LICENSE.txt.
Meshoptimizer decoder: Arseny Kapoulkine, MIT, see MESHOPT-LICENSE.txt.
ktx-parse and zstddec: Don McCurdy, MIT, see KTX-PARSE-LICENSE.txt and ZSTDDEC-LICENSE.txt.

gltf-codec-data.js embeds unmodified decoder bytes as base64, generated by
scripts/build_gltf_codecs.mjs. Runtime workers/WASM are loaded lazily from Blob
URLs, never a CDN. The IIFE build supplies a non-network default import.meta.url;
all active decoder paths are explicitly replaced with bundled resources.

Upstreams:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r185/examples/jsm
https://github.com/google/draco
https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal
https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer
https://github.com/donmccurdy/ktx-parse
https://github.com/donmccurdy/zstddec
